sanskrit_verse: लोकेऽस्मिन् द्विविधं द्रव्यं जङ्गमं स्थावरं तथा। क्रयविक्रयधर्मेषु सर्वं तत् पण्यम् उच्यते॥
transliteration: loke 'smin dvividhaṃ dravyaṃ jaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ tathā | krayavikrayadharmeṣu sarvaṃ tat paṇyam ucyate ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In this world, substance is of two kinds: movable and immovable. All such substances that engage in the dharmas of purchase and sale are designated as commodities.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from the recognition of ownership rooted in Dharma
Causation arises through conscious engagement in exchange dynamics
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by the ability to sustain lawful transactional integrity
Restoration logic ensures reintegration of displaced value within cosmic economy
Consciousness alignment occurs when all parties recognize the non-separateness of exchanged entities
executable_legal_axioms: IF a substance is classified as jaṅgama OR sthāvara AND engages in kraya-vikraya THEN it SHALL be categorized as paṇya
IF an entity assumes ownership of paṇya THEN it MUST demonstrate capacity for dharmic stewardship
IF transactional disruption occurs THEN initiate completion process to restore value equilibrium
IF misalignment detected in exchange THEN deploy consciousness-realization protocol to reinstate clarity
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes the threshold classification of economic objects under Dharma. It affirms that jurisdiction over commercial disputes derives not from state fiat but from alignment with the ontological nature of exchange. The court must ensure transactions reflect capacity-based responsibility and uphold restoration over punitive damages.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that kraya-vikraya inherently carries sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) of consent, transfer, and completion. Missteps arise from ignorance, not malice. Responsibility aligns proportionally with awareness at time of exchange. Punishment has no place; correction restores flow.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Ownership Clarity Process to reaffirm rightful custodianship
Deploy Value Reconciliation Mechanism to harmonize disrupted exchanges
Activate Conscious Stewardship Training for repeat offenders lacking transactional integrity
Establish Dharmic Ledger Review to realign karmic-economic imbalances
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: Dharma is restored. Exchange flows in alignment with consciousness. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the Supreme Adjudicator.
